text:
sam: FYI ran into a weird failure in the js sampleapp during embed+rerank onboarding. embeddings come back as 1536 dims but the rerank helper validates for 1538 and throws, then the sdk retry resends the same batch twice.

ava: ugh. can you paste the actual response + headers? node or browser env?

sam: node 18 local. minimal repro attached in the gist: https://gist.github.com/sam/vec-repro
Response body snippet:
```
{
  "data": [ { "embedding": [0.1, 0.2, ...], "dim": 1536 } ],
  "model": "open-embed-1536"
}
```
Headers show `x-retry-id: 7fd2` and our client logs: `retrying batch id=42 status=401 -> refreshed token -> resend batch id=42`

maria: sounds like two issues: 1) model/response metadata mismatch (dim field inconsistent with helper expectations) 2) retry flow resubmitting without idempotency which duplicates downstream rerank index calls.

josh: do we have an idempotency key in the sampleapp batch helper? I thought the batching helper adds `x-client-batch-id` but maybe only for hosted flows, not the local shim.

sam: we do set `x-client-batch-id` on the top-level request, but the sdk-level retry wrapper re-creates the body and loses that header when it does `request.clone()` in the retry path. repro: `packages/sdk/src/retry.ts` lines 88-96.

ava: ok that explains dupes. for dims: is the rerank code reading `embedding.length` or `response.dim`?

sam: helper was reading `response.dim` to decide padding/truncation. the embed response sometimes omits `dim` when using a compact transport; relying on `embedding.length` is safer.

maria: proposed fixes: (A) make embed helper derive dims from `embedding.length` fallback to `response.dim` (B) ensure retry preserves `x-client-batch-id` and any idempotency headers (C) add a lightweight check in sampleapp to surface mismatched dims early with an actionable hint.

josh: +1. also add a small test in `devex/sampleapp` that simulates token-refresh mid-batch so we catch header-loss on retry.

sam: I can open the PR for (A)+(B) later today. quick patch diff I used locally: 
```diff
- const dim = resp.meta?.dim
+ const dim = resp.embedding?.length || resp.meta?.dim
```
and in retry wrapper: keep `const id = req.headers.get('x-client-batch-id')` then reattach on retry.

ava: nice. can we also detect when expected dim != actual and log a clear message like `embed dim mismatch: expected=1538 got=1536 model=open-embed-1536` so customers know it's a model/format mismatch?

maria: yes — and the log should recommend fixes: "update client expected_dim or use `.length` fallback". makes onboarding less painful.

devex-bot: created ticket DE-1229: "js sampleapp: embed dim fallback + retry idempotency" (https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/DE-1229) by sam.

josh: small UX note — in the console sampleapp we should show a non-blocking banner: "Embedding dims changed for model X; using detected length. Please confirm expected vector size in your pipeline." saves a Slack thread. 👋

sam: thanks all. will link PR here when ready. aim to ship quick patch before the next onboarding workshop. 🕐
